profile.legalName: Motivating Inspiring Supporting And Serving Sexually Exploited Youth
profile.summary: MISSSEY is an Oakland nonprofit that supports girls and gender-expansive youth ages 12 to 25 who have been affected by sexual exploitation. It offers one-on-one coaching, a drop-in center, housing help in Alameda and Contra Costa Counties, and skills-building programs. It also provides training to community members and professionals on preventing sexual exploitation.
